description: Generate a slide-deck-quality Porter's five forces diagram laid out as the classic cross: competitive rivalry in the centre, threat of new entrants above, threat of substitutes below, bargaining power of suppliers on the left and of buyers on the right, with arrows pointing in at the centre. Each box has a header band with the force's name, an optional rating pill (very low, low, medium, high, very high; green, amber or red) and up to 5 short bullets of evidence; an optional conclusion line sits underneath. Choose it to assess an industry's attractiveness or competitive pressure for a strategy, market-entry, investment or case-interview slide. Use a Harvey ball matrix to score several options against criteria, a hub and spoke for items around a centre with no fixed meaning, and a mind map for open-ended brainstorming. All five forces are required (an empty object {} is fine); infer sensible ratings and bullets from the industry rather than asking. Limits: 5 bullets per force of about 4–10 words, a conclusion of one sentence. Infer missing details rather than asking; the user can adjust the chart in the builder through the Edit link. ALWAYS give the user the image link: inline chat images usually cannot be saved, but the link renders the exact chart on demand and can be pasted into a slide or Markdown.

buyers.description: Right box: how much leverage customers have to push prices down or demand more. Default name "Bargaining power of buyers". E.g. { "rating": "high", "bullets": ["Riders compare fares in seconds"] }.

bullets.description: The evidence for this force (0–5 short phrases, about 4–10 words each), listed in the box. Long ones wrap to 3 lines.

color.description: Optional hex colour for this box's header band, e.g. "#0ea5e9". Default: the first palette colour for every box, so ratings stay the only colour that carries meaning.

label.description: Name shown in the box's header band. Default "Bargaining power of buyers"; override only to rename it.

rating.description: Optional strength of this force, shown as a pill in the header: "very low", "low" (green), "medium" (amber), "high" or "very high" (red). Omit for no rating.

conclusion.description: Optional one-line takeaway shown in a muted band under the cross, e.g. "Overall: moderately attractive; buyer power is the main threat". Wraps to 2 lines. Omit for none.

credit.description: Shows a small "twominutetoolkit.com" credit under the chart, inside the card. Set false to leave it off (for example when the user asks for no branding).

look.description: Drawing style, the same in every tool. "regular": clean lines and Inter (the default). "bold": heavier, slightly larger type and thicker lines, for slides read from a distance. "sketch": hand-drawn, with a handwriting font and pen lines that wobble a little, for early ideas and workshops. Use the one the user asks for; otherwise leave it out.

newEntrants.description: Top box: how easily new competitors can enter the industry (capital needs, scale, brand, regulation). Default name "Threat of new entrants". E.g. { "rating": "high", "bullets": ["Network effects favour incumbents"] }.

bullets.description: The evidence for this force (0–5 short phrases, about 4–10 words each), listed in the box. Long ones wrap to 3 lines.

color.description: Optional hex colour for this box's header band, e.g. "#0ea5e9". Default: the first palette colour for every box, so ratings stay the only colour that carries meaning.

label.description: Name shown in the box's header band. Default "Threat of new entrants"; override only to rename it.

rating.description: Optional strength of this force, shown as a pill in the header: "very low", "low" (green), "medium" (amber), "high" or "very high" (red). Omit for no rating.

palette.description: Hex colours. Every header band takes the FIRST palette colour unless a force sets its own colour; rating pills always use green, amber and red. Default: indigo, sky, emerald, amber, red, gray.

rivalry.description: Centre box: how intensely existing competitors fight on price, product, marketing and service. Default name "Competitive rivalry". E.g. { "rating": "high", "bullets": ["Price war among the top two players","Low switching costs for riders"] }.

bullets.description: The evidence for this force (0–5 short phrases, about 4–10 words each), listed in the box. Long ones wrap to 3 lines.

showRatings.description: Show each force's rating pill. Default true; false hides every rating without deleting it.

bullets.description: The evidence for this force (0–5 short phrases, about 4–10 words each), listed in the box. Long ones wrap to 3 lines.

rating.description: Optional strength of this force, shown as a pill in the header: "very low", "low" (green), "medium" (amber), "high" or "very high" (red). Omit for no rating.

suppliers.description: Left box: how much leverage suppliers (inputs, labour, platforms) have over prices and terms. Default name "Bargaining power of suppliers". E.g. { "rating": "high", "bullets": ["Drivers multi-home across apps"] }.
